spans.s: चंकुर m. 1. A tree; 2. a carriage; 3. a vehicle in general.
चंक्रमण n. 1. Running, विषं चंक्रमणं रात्रौ
Cāṇakya.97
; 2. walking tortuously.

चंचा f. 1. Anything made of cane; 2. strawman, a doll.

चन ind. (according to some authorities, चन is not a separate word but a combination of the particles च and न) Not, also not, even not.(चन is not used by itself. It occurs in combination with the pronoun किम् or with कद्, कथम्, कदा, कुतस्, क्व &c. and imparts indefiniteness to the sense of the word it follows. Cf. चित् II.)
चंद m. 1. The moon; 2. camphire.

चंद्र m. 1. The moon, न हि संहरते ज्योत्न्सां चंद्रश्छांडालवेश्मनि Hit.i., पर्याप्तचंद्रेव शरत्त्रियामा K.S.vii.26; 2. the moon regarded as a planet; 3. the eye in a peacock’s tail; 4. camphor, विलेपनस्याधिकचंद्रभागताविभावनाच्चापललाप पांडुताम् Na.i.51; 5. water; 6. gold. (When used at the end of a compound चंद्र means ‘excellent,’ ‘eminent,’ e.g. पुरुषचंद्र).

चांद्रायण n. A religious observance or expiatory penance regulated by the waxing and waning of the moon; in it, the daily consumption of food is reduced from fifteen mouthfuls to nothing during the dark fortnight of a month, and then increased in the same manner during the bright fortnight. See Yaj.iii.324.

चांपेय (II) n. 1. The filament of a flower; 2. gold; 3. the dhattūra plant.
